entities.evidence_span: We recently proposed a method called Material Fingerprinting for the rapid discovery of mechanical material models that avoids solving continuous optimization problems.

evidence_spans: We recently proposed a method called Material Fingerprinting for the rapid discovery of mechanical material models that avoids solving continuous optimization problems.

Material Fingerprinting is a novel method for the rapid discovery of material models (Flaschel et al., 2026a). It oper-ates by precomputing a database of material responses, a.k.a. fingerprints, and their corresponding material models in an offline stage, which is subsequently leveraged in an online stage to identify the appropriate material model for an unseen experimental measurement via a pattern-recognition algorithm.
